text: Probes low expression inconsistent signal (MAS5 “Absent” calls) can introduce noise. filter dataset retain high-quality, reliable probes. can play around min_present parameter find optimum filtering option. also good practice run QC diagnostics filtering.

title: Circadian Liver Microarray Data (GSE11923) — CircadianData
text: objects ExpressionSet objects: eset Normalized, probe-level expression data (GCRMA). Contains 96 samples (48 time points duplicate). Feature metadata includes gene symbols, gene names, MAS5 presence/absence calls. eset_collapsed Gene-level expression data. Probes collapsed unique gene symbols using MaxMean method via WGCNA's collapseRows function. object class ExpressionSet 45101 rows 48 columns. object class ExpressionSet 21032 rows 48 columns.
